notes: Groww's careers page links to its Greenhouse EU board (9 jobs). The board is a React/Remix app: search input #keyword-filter, department combobox #department-filter and office combobox #office-filter, with loader state departmentIds/officeIds and include_department_filter true. Filtering happens in the client; the URL query names for these controls were not confirmed, so the full board is fetched and filtered locally.
